boms: select b.{{id:boms}} as id, b.name, b.product_category, b.product_category__label as category, b.total_cogs, b.target_margin, b.bom_file, b.notes, b.created_at, (select count(*) from associations a where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'lines' and a.record_id = b.{{id:boms}}) as parts, (select sum(coalesce(l.quantity, 0) * coalesce(l.unit_cost, l.unit_price, 0)) from associations a join lines l on l.pc_0020_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'lines' and a.record_id = b.{{id:boms}}) as parts_cost from boms b order by b.created_at desc

parts.sql: select l.pc_0020_id as id, l.name, l.sku, l.quantity, coalesce(l.unit_cost, l.unit_price) as unit_cost, coalesce(l.amount, l.quantity * coalesce(l.unit_cost, l.unit_price)) as extended from associations a join lines l on l.pc_0020_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'lines' and a.record_id = :id order by l.created_at, l.pc_0020_id

categories: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:boms}}' and property = 'product_category' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
